assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: original wide 16:9 clean stage background for a 26-second Council Lab film and public GitHub README. Depict a recognizably modest public library in the Shadow Theatre aesthetic: ink-black angular hand-cut paper shapes, richly textured aged parchment, restrained muted olive-gold window light, fine engraved and screenprinted surface detail, handcrafted cinematic composition. On the LEFT third are deep black silhouettes of library shelves and an arched window with pale olive daylight. In the MID-RIGHT is a small separate study-room doorway in the back with a table and eight seats suggested very subtly. Across the LOWER quarter, a beautifully simple long service-desk counter extends from x25% to x95%, seen at three-quarter side view, with the top at 70% image height and front edge at 77%, a front panel descending to 98%. This counter is EMPTY, perfectly clean for animated paper props and a librarian to be composited behind it later. Leave a large uninterrupted pale illuminated parchment area in the upper middle for readable editorial titles. Atmosphere quiet, humane, thoughtful; a practical library, no fantasy city. Art direction: sophisticated shadow theatre, near-black cutout contours, layered paper grain, tangible soft directional cast shadows; few large masses with generous open space. No people or body parts anywhere. No books or loose props on the desk. No letters, no text, no logos, no UI, no robots, no watermarks. This is a NEW illustration; do not imitate any named artist. Wide landscape composition.
